name: Wire lever-connector line
product: Three wires (red, white, black) cut to length against a ruler, laid in color order (red top, white middle, black bottom) and closed in a 3-port lever connector. A second lever connector joins the other end of the red wire to a separate black wire. QA is a pull test: no wire may come out of either connector.

failReasons.label: Wire pulled out of connector 1 (the 3-wire connector)
Wire pulled out of connector 2 (red to black)

stations.label: Cut
stations.output: one wire cut to length per cycle (three cycles per unit: red, white, black)
stations.note: One cycle is one wire. The operator cuts and checks the red, white and black wire in turn, so a unit is three S1 cycles.

substeps.label: Check for correct length against the ruler

stations.label: Arrange and clamp
stations.output: the three wires closed in lever connector 1, red top, white middle, black bottom

substeps.label: Open the lever connector
substeps.note: Once per cycle: the connector stays open while the wires are arranged, so seeing it open again is not a repeat.

substeps.label: Arrange the wires: red top, white middle, black bottom
substeps.note: Only after the connector was seen open: hands moving over the wires before that are not arranging.

substeps.label: Close the levers on the wires
substeps.note: Done = the unit_complete check, or the connector closed at 0.75+ for 3 s after it was seen open (the black-wire pixel check misses on dark wood tables).

stations.label: Second connector
stations.output: a second lever connector joining the other end of the red wire to a black wire

substeps.label: Add a new lever connector to the other end of the red wire
Get a black wire
substeps.note: Model: a second black wire in view (the unit already has one). Optional: a black wire on a dark table is easy to miss, so a miss is not a mistake.

substeps.label: Insert the black wire into the new connector
substeps.note: Done = the model sees two closed connectors (the arrived one and the new one) for 3 s, only after the new connector was seen open. Zones only when the model is off.

stations.label: QA pull test
stations.output: one tested unit, pass or fail
stations.note: The camera sees the unit arrive; the pull test result comes from the P or F key, and S4's cycle count comes from those presses.

substeps.label: Pull test: no wire comes out of either connector, then P or F
substeps.note: No camera rule: the answer-key keeper presses P or F after the pull test.
